releaseNotes:
• Secure Action Nonce Verification: Live nonce issuance for registration prep & commit, eliminating nonce expiration and stale request errors

• Humanized Server Error Diagnostics: Clear, actionable error messages for slot availability, clock skew, and expired requests
• Real-Time Network Sync: Optimized background mutation handling and cache consistency
